prompts.title: Recent form · rhythmic results
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16 frame, about 9 seconds, two presentations joined by a transition. Editorial variant — kinetic typography: full-bleed charcoal #101412, condensed uppercase display type in warm white #edf0e6, lime #c5ed74 reserved for Everton FC, slate #8ca6bf for Chelsea FC, one focal word at a time, permanent lower quarter left clear for yellow subtitles. Stage one: the Spanish words VICTORIAS, EMPATES, DERROTAS punch in centre-frame on three rhythmic beats, each snapping from a slight over-scale to rest with a one-frame lime flash. Stage two: a hard transition splits the frame and the team names EVERTON FC and CHELSEA FC lock to the upper-left and upper-right thirds above a shared rule. Stage three: a staccato edit strobes the generic heading FORMA RECIENTE, words sliding up behind rectangular masks with alternating lime and slate underlines. Camera: locked frame with a slow digital push-in, then a whip-pan transition to the statistical variant; exit is a left-to-right shutter wipe. No axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Statistical variant — grouped count bars on the same charcoal field: a shared vertical axis labelled 'partidos' running from a single zero baseline, common scale for every bar, three groups along the horizontal axis — Spanish labels 'Victorias', 'Empates', 'Derrotas' — each group holding two adjacent bars, Everton FC in lime, Chelsea FC in slate. Values: {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}} and {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}}. A compact source and sample line sits above the lower quarter: 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · sample de {{home.n}} partidos y de {{away.n}} partidos'. Stage one: axis, gridlines and baseline draw from left to right. Stage two: bars grow from zero with a stagger, unit ticks fading in. Stage three: matching win bars receive a shared highlight ring. Camera: gentle vertical drift, exit transition via a bar wipe.

prompts.title: Goals for and against · pitch path
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, roughly 10 seconds, two presentations with a clear transition. Editorial variant — illustrative football pitch and ball path: charcoal #101412 ground with a simplified pitch drawn in thin warm white #edf0e6 lines, half-way line centred, no numbers anywhere. Stage one: the pitch rotates in from a steep tilt to face the camera while the Spanish heading GOLES fades up in condensed type. Stage two: two stylised ball paths arc across the frame — one traced in lime #c5ed74 running left to right, one in slate #8ca6bf running right to left — each path drawing itself with a glowing head and a soft motion trail, plus small Spanish labels 'ATAQUE' and 'DEFENSA' at the ends. Stage three: EVERTON FC and CHELSEA FC settle into the upper-left and upper-right thirds with a lime and slate underline pulse, one focal element at a time, lower quarter reserved for yellow subtitles. Camera: slow dolly toward the centre circle, then a transition where the pitch collapses into a horizon line. Exit: lines retract and the frame returns to plain charcoal. No statistical axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Statistical variant — paired bars on charcoal: a shared vertical axis labelled 'goles' from one zero baseline, one common scale for all four bars, two paired groups — Spanish labels 'Goles a favor' and 'Goles recibidos' — each pair holding Everton FC in lime and Chelsea FC in slate, unit 'goles' printed beside the axis. Values: {{home.gf}}, {{home.ga}}, {{away.gf}}, {{away.ga}}. Above the lower quarter sits the source and sample annotation: 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · sample de {{home.n}} partidos y de {{away.n}} partidos'. Stage one: axis and baseline draw in; stage two: bars grow from zero with a light stagger; stage three: the tallest bar in each pair pulses once with a lime outline. Camera drifts up a few units, then transition out with a horizontal bar wipe.

prompts.title: Clean sheets · defensive shield
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 8 seconds, editorial first, then a transition into the statistical version. Editorial variant — defensive energy with a stylised shield: charcoal #101412 background, a large geometric shield silhouette outlined in warm white #edf0e6 and filled with a faint lime #c5ed74 glow, permanent lower quarter clear for yellow subtitles. Stage one: the shield scales up from a small crest with an impact shake while the Spanish heading ARCOS EN CERO types on letter by letter. Stage two: the shield splits into two halves — left half tinted lime for EVERTON FC, right half tinted slate #8ca6bf for CHELSEA FC — the team names sliding in from opposite edges and locking on a shared baseline, one focal half lit at a time. Stage three: radiating short strokes flicker around the lime half like energy arcs while the slate half stays quiet, creating the visual tension. Camera: locked frame with a subtle parallax on the shield layers, then a transition where the shield folds into a vertical divider. Exit: shapes contract to centre and fade. No statistical axes, no sample claims, no invented match events. Statistical variant — grouped count bars on the same charcoal field: a shared vertical axis labelled 'partidos', one zero baseline and one common scale for both bars, two bars only — Everton FC in lime, Chelsea FC in slate — with Spanish labels 'Arcos en cero' under each bar and the unit 'partidos' beside the axis. Values: {{home.clean}} and {{away.clean}}. A compact source and sample line sits directly above the lower quarter: 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · sample de {{home.n}} partidos y de {{away.n}} partidos'. Stage one: axis and baseline draw from left to right. Stage two: both bars grow from zero simultaneously so the shared scale reads clearly. Stage three: a bracket annotation joins the two bars with the Spanish caption 'Conteos, no tasas'. Camera drifts slightly upward, then transition out with a vertical wipe.

prompts.title: Head-to-head · visual duel
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 10 seconds, editorial duel first, then a transition to the statistical reading. Editorial variant — both teams as a visual duel: charcoal #101412 stage, a vertical seam of warm white #edf0e6 light down the centre, lower quarter reserved for yellow subtitles. Stage one: EVERTON FC enters from the left edge and CHELSEA FC from the right, each on a lime #c5ed74 or slate #8ca6bf angled chevron, meeting at the seam with a single impact flash. Stage two: the Spanish heading CRUCES PREVIOS slides up behind a rectangular mask between them; concentric rings ripple outward from the impact point. Stage three: the chevrons push alternately a few units toward the centre in a slow back-and-forth rhythm, one side lit at a time, then both settle to equal depth on the shared baseline. Camera: locked frame with a two-unit push-in on the impact and a gentle ease back; transition is a chevron-shaped wipe splitting the seam open. Exit: the seam widens to full charcoal. No statistical axes, no sample claims, no invented match events, and no forecast language. Statistical variant — grouped count bars on charcoal: a shared horizontal axis labelled 'partidos' from one zero baseline, single common scale, three groups with Spanish labels 'Everton FC · victorias', 'Empates', 'Chelsea FC · victorias', one bar each, Everton in lime, Chelsea in slate, draws in warm white at reduced height of tone only. Values: {{h2h.homeWins}}, {{h2h.draws}}, {{h2h.awayWins}}, with the total sample shown as 'Total de cruces: {{h2h.total}} partidos'. Source and sample annotation above the lower quarter: 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · sample de {{h2h.total}} partidos históricos · Datos históricos, no es una predicción'. Stage one: axis draws in; stage two: bars grow from zero with a stagger; stage three: a bracket spans all three bars and the Spanish caption 'Historial' fades on. Camera drifts sideways, exit transition via an angled wipe.

prompts.title: Synthesis · defence against attack
prompts.prompt: Vertical 9:16, about 9 seconds, closing the montage with a creative reveal and one grounded statistical statement. Editorial variant — team reveals and narrative emphasis: charcoal #101412 field with large warm white #edf0e6 type, lower quarter permanently clear for yellow subtitles. Stage one: two vertical panels of light rise from the bottom edge — left panel lime #c5ed74, right panel slate #8ca6bf — while the Spanish heading LA TENSIÓN wipes on letter by letter between them. Stage two: the panels part to reveal EVERTON FC on the left and CHELSEA FC on the right, each name rising behind a mask with a soft glow and a slight overshoot, one focal name at a time. Stage three: a single warm white diagonal line connects the two names and pulses twice while the Spanish sub-heading DEFENSA Y ATAQUE holds centre frame. Camera: locked 9:16 frame with a slow push-in and a shallow parallax between panels and type; transition into the statistical variant is a diagonal split wipe. Exit: panels slide down and the frame settles to plain charcoal. No axes, no sample claims, no invented match events, no forecast language. Statistical variant — paired comparison bars on charcoal: one shared vertical axis labelled 'goles', a single zero baseline and one common scale for both bars, two bars side by side — Everton FC in lime reading {{home.ga}} with the Spanish label 'Everton FC · goles recibidos', Chelsea FC in slate reading {{away.gf}} with the Spanish label 'Chelsea FC · goles a favor' — both measured in 'goles' over comparable samples. Source and sample annotation above the lower quarter: 'Fuente: Bzzoiro · sample de {{home.n}} partidos y de {{away.n}} partidos · Comparación histórica'. Stage one: axis and baseline draw in; stage two: bars grow from zero together; stage three: a bracket joins both tops with the Spanish caption 'Misma unidad'. Camera drifts upward, then transition out with a centre-out shutter.
